title: Source x target x layer factorized bridge
scope: Tests cross-model hidden-state bridge transfer and compression only; not StitchLLM reproduction, task-level semantic equivalence, or serving benchmark.
controls: independent affine connector per ordered model pair and bridge layer trained on same fitting stories
source x target x layer factorized shared basis trained only on non-heldout ordered pairs
metrics: target-tail KL divergence from native target logits

gates.promising: factorized connector reduces heldout pair loss within 10% of independent control while using <=25% connector bytes and no >2x connector MACs
gates.fail: factorized loss >25% worse than independent or no useful byte advantage

boundaries: No StitchLLM end-to-end NLL/throughput or semantic-equivalence claim.
PA241 warns representation matching can preserve output while losing information; report counterfactual/task limitations.
All base model weights and tokenizer/config metadata are included in full deployment byte accounting; connector-only bytes are reported separately.
results_scope: Scoped failure for rank-8 B_target C_layer A_source bridge on TinyStories; not StitchLLM end-to-end.
